text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp of our third year came to a close.
As for whether it was fruitful...
one look at North Flight's face tells you all you need to know.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
It's hard to say goodbye, but—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Everything I gained from the training camp... is already woven into this body.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Heading toward the Swan Stakes where Sakura Bakushin O awaits... we ramp up our training even further.
